items.text: Kosodi kejenu Yakob ebe ejaas akima Misiri, kotema Yakob odweke atiar, “Kanukinyo inolianakinotor?”
Kotema atiar, “Koany, apup ebe ejaas akima Misiri: aso kiiesaros kogwelut kaŋina; kajarata, kenyeis atwakare.”
Kiiesaros iinacan lutomon luka Yosep agwel akima Misiri.
Konye mam Yakob abu kiyakia Benyamin onace loka Yosep, nepepe kikeinacan; naarai abala ebe, “Elemuni kodoik aronis.”
Kopotu odwe luka Isirael egwelet nepepe kanul kaluaponenenete: naarai ajai ebeli akwap naka Kanaan.
Kerai Yosep ekayaiton loka akwap; nol ŋes loetwegelenenei ituŋa kere luka akwap; kopotu iinacan luka Yosep, kisudedoto kakonyencke.
Koany Yosep ikeinacan kojen kes, konye kituluor bala lokaceteker kamakec, kisiejanak, kobala kes ebe, “Kipote kai?” Kotemasi ŋes ebe, “Akwap naka Kanaan agwel inyamat.”
Kojen Yosep ikeinacan, konye mam kes apotu kojenutu ŋes,
Kiitu Yosep airuiasia nuerujai kanukec, kotema kes atiar, “Iraas ikarotak: iponito aanyun akwap kwape ilarononor.”
Kobalas ebe, “Mam, papa, konye eponitos ikonibulesin egwelet inyamat.
Isio ke re kirai idwe luka ediopetunanan; kirai da lukabeit, ikonibulesin mam eraas ikarctak nepetai da.”
Kobala kes ebe, “Mam, konye iponitos aanyun akwap kwape ilarononor.”
Kobalas ebe, “Mam. Isio ikonibulesin kirai iinacan lutomon kaarei, idwe luka ediopetunanan kakwap naka Kanaan; ido koany, ikosiŋoorit ejai nepepe kapapakosi kiton lolo, idiopet da emamei.”
Kobala Yosep kes ebe, “Ŋes nipenin nakabalar eoŋ yes ebe ‘Iraas ikarotak’;
Mere ber kigimoroi akusikirot. Madi Parao, mam inyounete kane dimikito kebu ikusinoorit da nepene.
Kiyakiasi aupakus ediopet, koom onaeekus, ka yes da kienio, tetere igimorio akusikiro, arai ejai abeit mamakus; arai mere kwaŋin, madi Parao, abeit iraas ikarotak.”
Kibwaik kes kere nepepe aidaris apaarasia auni.
Kobala Yosep kes kapaaran kanakiwuniet ebe, “Kiswamata kwanata, tetere ijarete: naarai ayoŋit eoŋ Edeke.
Arai teni iraas lukabeit, koenai cani ediopet koinacanakus kaidarisikus; konye kolototo luce, koyanaasi akima nuka eteŋei lokokalekus;
ido koinuniata inooritikus; kosodete akirokus aitogogoŋio, yes da mam itwakete.” Kiswamata kwaŋin,
Kotemanaros bonik ebe, “Abeit kidiakarit kanuka onaeewok, naarai kipou kaanyutu eketau kwape eticanitor, kwape kinainaitor, oni da kipou kagiro apupun; ŋes kidoikinioto ican lu.”
Koboŋok Reuben kes ebe, “Mam eoŋ abu kalimok yes ebe, ‘Sirikidiakata nuka ikoku’; kosodete yes aigir apupun? ŋes kitepesenitotor oni akeokot.”
Mam apotu kojenut ebe ejeŋi Yosep akecekiro; naarai ajai ekejulan kidinike kakes.
Kibonok kes epur, komony akiyo; kobono bobo mama ejaas, kiner kakes, kocupo Simeon kokidinikec, koen kakonyekec.
Kosodi Yosep aicorakin ailelebanar iborokec akima, ainyakakin da ŋolituŋanan akepesan opukoke, ainanakin da inyamat luka erot: kiswamanakinai kwaŋin.
Naalaearia aupakec ediopet epukoke aitanyam akesigiria kaibois naaperete, koturiaikin akepesan; ido koany, kejaas aituk naka epukoke.
Kotema ikeinacan atiar, “Kenyakakin akapesan; ido koany, ejaas opukoka.” Kodusaununos itauonokec, kibelonokinos komaranete, kobalas ebe, “Inyo bo lolo yenikisubak oni Edeke?”
Kopotu neejai papakec Yakob akwap naka Kanaan, kolimonokis kere nuapotu kodoikis kes; ebe,
“Etuŋanan, ekapolon loka akwap, abu kisiejanak sio, koomite ebe kirai isio ikarotak akwap.
Katemasi atiar,, Kirai lukabcit; mam kirai ikarotak;
Kirai iinaean lutomon ka luarei, odwe luka papakosi; idiopet emamei, ikosiŋoorit da ejai kapapakosi kiton lolo kakwap naka Kanaan.’
Etuŋanan, ekapolon loka akwap, kotema sio atiar, ‘Kwanata ŋes ajenunia ebe iraas lukabeit; kinyeinere ediopet koinaeanakus, koyanaasi akima kanuka eteŋei lokokaliakus, koloto.
Koinut ikusinoorit; kasodi kaien ebe mam eut iraas ikarotak, konye iraas lukabcit; kalaeakinete do onaeekus, yes da igwelenenete do kakwap kana.’’’
Kosodi ebukete iboro lukotoma opukoikee, koany, eriagi loka apesan loka nolitunanan kojai opukoke: keanyutu kesi ka papakee iriaginikee luka apesan, kokuriakaros.
Kobala papakec Yakob kes ebe, “Kidemasi eoŋ ikadwe: Yosep emamei, Simeon da emamei, ido bobo kikotos ademar Benyamin da; ŋun kere kalanirikinitos.”
Kotema Reuben papake ebe, “lari ijo odweka luarei, arai mam enyakunit mamakon; koinakinai akanika, enyakuni eoŋ ŋes bobo mamakon.”
Kobala ebe, “Mam ikakoku elosi nepepe kayes; naarai abu onaceke kotwana, ŋes da asalaki bon; kedoiki aronis korot kaloitorete, itolomarete akakorwo toma okatwak kanuka aiturur.”
